findings.defect: The card offers a CHOICE of two mutually exclusive modes ('attack ... or stops ...'), but the parse lists both effects on a single 'attack' ability, so the engine performs the 5-life-card energy attack AND resolves a physical-attack stop (the stopAttack lands in ifSuccessfulEffects and fires on success). One card would do the work of two.
findings.evidence: Energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage, or stops a physical attack.
findings.expected: Two alternative modes, or a single chosen mode — not energyAttack(5) plus stopAttack(physical) resolving together.

findings.name: Black Saving Drill
findings.defect: attackType is 'energy', but the card stops a physical OR an energy attack. As parsed, the drill silently declines to stop physical attacks — exactly half the cases it is printed to cover.
findings.evidence: Stops the first physical or energy attack your opponent performs in Combat
findings.expected: { kind: 'stopAttack', attackType: 'any', ... } (compare Blue Prepared Drill/Black Shifting Drill, where the printed text really is single-type).

findings.name: Cell Jr.'s Flight
findings.defect: Two errors from one mis-read. (1) lifeCards: 1 is set on the physicalAttack, and per the schema a fixed lifeCards OVERRIDES the Physical Attack Table base — so the attack deals exactly 1 life card instead of table damage. The text's '+1 life card ... for each Cell Jr.' is an ADDITIONAL, variable bonus, not a fixed base. (2) Because fixed damage was detected, the parser suppressed the '+2 power stages' modifier entirely, so the printed stage bonus is lost.
findings.evidence: Physical attack doing +2 power stages of damage and +1 life card of damage for each Cell Jr. you have in play.
findings.expected: { kind: 'physicalAttack' } (no lifeCards override) plus { kind: 'damageStages', stages: 2 }; the per-Cell-Jr. life-card bonus is variable and should be left unmodeled rather than pinned to a flat base of 1.

findings.name: Blue Recovery Drill
findings.defect: The parse keeps only the COST and drops the payoff: the user discards a card and gets nothing. 'Raise your Main Personality to his highest power rating' is directly expressible as movePowerStage{target:'user', to:'highest'} (the parser emits exactly that elsewhere, abilities.ts:319) but its regex demands the words 'highest stage' and this card says 'highest power rating'. Trigger 'onPlay' also fires the discard when the drill hits the table, not after dealing 5+ life cards.
findings.evidence: discard 1 card from your hand to raise your Main Personality to his highest power rating
findings.expected: { kind: 'movePowerStage', target: 'user', to: 'highest' } as the effect, with the discard expressed as cost.discard = 1 — never a bare discard with no benefit.

findings.name: Cell's Charge
findings.defect: 'Gain 3 power stages' is dropped entirely, though changePowerStages is in the vocabulary and applies to the attacker. The parse under-delivers the card by 3 power stages of self-empowerment.
findings.evidence: Gain 3 power stages.
findings.expected: Add { kind: 'changePowerStages', target: 'user', delta: 3 } alongside physicalAttack and damageStages 3.

findings.name: Blue Windup Blast
findings.defect: lifeCards: 1 is recorded as the attack's fixed damage, but 1 is the per-card rate, not the total. The engine sets energyLifeCards = 1, so a card that scales to 10 life cards always deals exactly 1 — worse than the 4-life-card energy default and far from the printed ceiling.
findings.evidence: 1 life card of damage for each U card in your discard pile, to a maximum of 10 life cards
findings.expected: Variable damage the engine cannot compute — leave the amount unmodeled/manual rather than committing to a flat lifeCards: 1.

findings.name: Megaton Bull Crusher
findings.defect: damageStages: 1 records the per-card rate as the whole modifier. The bonus is '+1 for EACH C card in your discard pile' up to +10, so the parse under-reports the attack by up to 9 power stages in the states where the card is actually played.
findings.evidence: +1 power stages of damage for each C card in your discard pile, to a maximum of +10 power stages
findings.expected: Variable modifier — leave unmodeled/manual rather than a flat damageStages: 1.

findings.name: Learning the Moves
findings.defect: The parse grants an unconditional stopAttack on any physical or energy attack with no cost attached. The printed stop is payable only by discarding a copy of the very card being played; AbilityCost.discard exists in the vocabulary but is absent here, so the engine offers a free universal stop.
findings.evidence: you may stop that attack by discarding a copy of that card from your hand
findings.expected: cost.discard = 1 at minimum (the 'copy of that card' matching requirement is unmodelable, which argues for flagging this card manual rather than exposing a costless any-attack stop).

findings.name: Blue Devastation
findings.defect: An attack card is parsed as a pure defense card. Trigger is 'defense' and the only effect is a stopAttack; the physical attack and its +3 stage modifier are absent entirely. 'Sensei Deck.' is only a deck-placement note (CRD line 100), not a defense marker. The stop it does encode is also wrong three ways: it is conditional on both players' Tokui-Waza declarations, it covers 'physical or energy' (not energy-only), and it stops the NEXT attack this Combat, not the current one.
findings.evidence: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage.
findings.expected: trigger 'attack' with effects [physicalAttack, damageStages stages:3]; the conditional next-attack stop is unmodelable (Tokui-Waza gate) and should be dropped or left to manual

findings.name: Blue Draining Blast
findings.defect: energyAttack.lifeCards:1 sets a FIXED base of 1 life card, overriding the 4-life-card default. The '1' in the text is a per-2-stages-paid bonus, not the base. Engine deals 1 life card where the card deals 4 (plus riders).
findings.evidence: For ever 2 power stages paid, this attack does an additional +1 life cards of damage.
findings.expected: energyAttack with no lifeCards (default 4), cost.powerStages 0; the variable Empower-style rider is unmodelable

findings.name: Blue Eye Gouge
findings.defect: physicalAttack.lifeCards:1 pulls the '1 life card' out of the attachment-duration clause and turns it into a fixed 1-life-card base, which overrides the Physical Attack Table entirely. On top of that the actual damage modifier, +3 power stages, is missing.
findings.evidence: attach this card to your Main Personality until your opponent successfully deals at least 1 life card of damage to you
findings.expected: physicalAttack (no lifeCards, PAT base) + damageStages stages:3

findings.name: Blue Head Kick
findings.defect: An attack card is parsed as a defense card. Trigger 'defense' with only preventLifeCards; the physical attack and its +4 stage modifier are missing. The prevention is also mis-scoped: it is conditional on the opponent's Main Personality being a Majin, and it applies to ALL attacks, not physical ones only.
findings.evidence: Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage.
findings.expected: trigger 'attack' with [physicalAttack, damageStages stages:4]; the Majin-conditional prevention (attackType 'any') is not unconditionally applicable

findings.name: Blue Protective Bubble
findings.defect: stopAttack.attackType is 'energy', but the card stops either attack type. As parsed the engine refuses to let this card stop a physical attack. The preventLifeCards is likewise typed 'energy' and its amount is per-card-removed, not a flat 2.
findings.evidence: Stops a physical or energy attack.
findings.expected: stopAttack attackType 'any', window 'thisAttack'; preventLifeCards attackType 'any' (amount is per Sensei card removed, arguably unmodelable) + removeFromGameAfterUse

findings.name: Blue Style Mastery
findings.defect: preventLifeCards.attackType is 'physical', but the prevention applies to whatever attack is being defended against, of either type. The word 'physical' was lifted from the unrelated first sentence about Blue Style attack damage. As parsed the Mastery silently fails to prevent energy damage.
findings.evidence: Prevent 2 life cards of damage from the attack for each Blue Style card removed.
findings.expected: preventLifeCards attackType 'any' (amount scales per Blue Style card removed)

findings.name: Broly's Supreme Power
findings.defect: stopAttack.attackType is 'energy', but the card stops either attack type. As parsed the engine will not let it stop a physical attack.
findings.evidence: Stops a physical or energy attack.
findings.expected: stopAttack attackType 'any', window 'thisAttack' (the second use this Combat is unmodelable)

findings.name: Carpet Attack Technique
findings.defect: Life cards and power stages are conflated: the parse gives physicalAttack.lifeCards:3, but the printed fixed base is 3 POWER STAGES. These are different damage currencies (CRD line 449/422), so the engine deals 3 life cards instead of 3 power stages off the opponent's personality. The '3 life cards' number appears to have been scavenged from the conditional '+3 life cards' rider.
findings.evidence: Physical attack doing 3 power stages of damage.
findings.expected: physicalAttack powerStages:3 + removeFromGameAfterUse; the per-Non-Combat-discarded +3 life cards rider is unmodelable

findings.name: Cookie!
findings.defect: The power-stage restoration is dropped even though the vocabulary covers it (movePowerStage target:'user', to:'highest'). Only the anger gain was captured, so the card's primary effect does nothing.
findings.evidence: Raise Majin Buu to his highest power stage.
findings.expected: [movePowerStage target 'user' to 'highest', changeAnger user +1]

findings.name: Energy Ricochet
findings.defect: Only the opponent's anger drop was captured; the user's own anger gain is missing, even though changeAnger target:'user' exists. Both clauses are printed side by side, so the parser saw one and skipped the other.
findings.evidence: Raise your anger 1 level. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level.
findings.expected: [stopAttack energy thisAttack, changeAnger user +1, changeAnger foe -1]

findings.name: Gohan's Kamehameha
findings.defect: energyAttack.lifeCards:1 fixes the base at 1 life card, overriding the 4-life-card default. The printed 1 is a per-Kamehameha-in-discard-pile bonus on top of the default base, so the engine deals 1 where the card deals 4 + X.
findings.evidence: Focused energy attack doing +1 life cards of damage for each card in your discard pile with "Kamehameha" in the title.
findings.expected: energyAttack with no lifeCards (default 4) + changeAnger user +1; the per-card rider is unmodelable

findings.name: Goku, Super Saiyan
findings.defect: changeAnger user +1 is applied unconditionally, but the text's anger gain is optional and costs removing 7 Saiyan Style cards from the discard pile, is limited to once per turn, and is not 1 level. Combined with trigger 'defense', the engine would hand the player a free anger level every time this personality defends.
findings.evidence: you may remove 7 Saiyan Style cards in your discard pile from the game to raise your anger b levels
findings.expected: preventLifeCards amount:2 attackType:'any' only; the costed anger gain has no vocabulary and should be dropped or left manual

findings.name: Goku's Escape
findings.defect: Only the opponent's anger drop was captured; the user's own anger gain is missing despite changeAnger target:'user' being available.
findings.evidence: Raise your anger 1 level. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level.
findings.expected: [energyAttack lifeCards:6? no — lifeCards:5, changeAnger user +1, changeAnger foe -1]

findings.name: Goku's Face Break
findings.defect: physicalAttack.lifeCards:7 replaces the Physical Attack Table base with a fixed 7 life cards, taken from a bonus that only applies with 6+ Drills in play. Meanwhile the unconditional +3 power stage modifier is missing entirely. Every use of this card resolves as a flat 7 life cards regardless of board state.
findings.evidence: If you have 6 or more Drills in play, this is a focused attack and does an additional +7 life cards of damage.
findings.expected: physicalAttack (PAT base) + damageStages stages:3 + removeFromGameAfterUse; the Drill-conditional +7 is unmodelable

findings.name: Goku's Power Strike
findings.defect: physicalAttack.lifeCards:4 replaces the Physical Attack Table base with a fixed 4 life cards, sourced from a level-2+ conditional rider, and the unconditional +4 power stage modifier is dropped. The card's actual damage (PAT + 4 stages) never happens.
findings.evidence: Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage.
findings.expected: physicalAttack (PAT base) + damageStages stages:4; the level-2+ conditional +4 life cards is unmodelable

findings.name: Goku's Running Defense
findings.defect: Only the single-attack stop was captured. The second, much larger effect — a blanket stop for the rest of Combat — is dropped, even though the vocabulary has window:'thisCombat' / scope:'all' for exactly this.
findings.evidence: Stops all non-focused energy attacks performed against you for the remainder of Combat.
findings.expected: [stopAttack energy thisAttack, stopAttack energy window 'thisCombat' scope 'all', removeFromGameAfterUse]

findings.name: Gotenks Flight
findings.defect: changeAnger foe delta:0 is a no-op — it cannot express 'lowers anger to 0' (changeAnger has no toZero flag, unlike changePowerStages). It is also unconditional in the parse while the text gates it on a Fused Personality. Either the anger reset silently never happens, or if the engine ever treats delta 0 specially it happens for personalities that shouldn't get it.

findings.expected: [{physicalAttack},{damageStages:2},{changeAnger user +1}] — no lifeCards on the attack.

findings.name: Super Saiyan Goku
findings.defect: The printed base modifier "+2 power stages of damage" is dropped, and physicalAttack.lifeCards=2 was taken from the conditional per-Dragon-Ball rider, making it a fixed 2-life-card base that overrides the Physical Attack Table.
findings.evidence: Focused physical attack doing +2 power stages of damage. If your opponent declared a Tokui-Waza, this attack does an additional +2 life cards of damage for each Dragon Ball your opponent controls.
findings.expected: [{physicalAttack},{damageStages:2}] — no lifeCards; the conditional per-Dragon-Ball rider is unmodelable.

findings.name: Super Saiyan Trunks
findings.defect: This is a Defense Shield that automatically stops the first 2 unstopped physical attacks across the whole Combat. The parse uses window 'thisAttack', which models a single hand-played stop of the current attack — wrong window and wrong count, even though 'firstSuccessful'/'thisCombat' exist in the enum.
findings.evidence: Defense Shield: Stops the first 2 unstopped physical attacks performed on you during Combat.
findings.expected: stopAttack physical with window 'firstSuccessful' (count of 2 flagged as needsReview), not window 'thisAttack'.

findings.name: Total Defense Drill
findings.defect: The stop requires discarding a card from hand as a cost, but the parse carries no cost, so the engine gets an unlimited free stop of any attack from a Drill that is permanently in play.
findings.evidence: you may discard a card from your hand to stop a non-focused attack
findings.expected: cost {discard:1} on the ability (AbilityCost.discard exists) alongside the stopAttack.

findings.name: Black Arm Stretch
findings.defect: Two distinct things were collapsed into one effect: the unconditional "+3 power stages of damage" modifier and the separate "If successful, gain 3 power stages" reward. The parse emits a single damageStages:3 flagged ifSuccessful, so the user never gains the 3 power stages, and the damage modifier is misfiled as a post-success effect (CRD step 15) rather than part of the attack's damage.
findings.evidence: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. If successful, gain 3 power stages.
findings.expected: [{physicalAttack},{damageStages:3} (no ifSuccessful),{changePowerStages target:'user', delta:+3}]

findings.name: Black Overhead Smack
findings.defect: The "If successful" clause governs the hand-shuffle effect, not the damage. The parse moved the gate onto the printed damage modifier (damageStages:3... ifSuccessful:true on a +2 modifier), so the attack's own damage is modeled as a separate post-success effect resolved at CRD step 15 rather than as attack damage subject to normal prevention/redirection.
findings.evidence: Physical attack doing +2 power stages of damage. Empower 3. If successful, your opponent shuffles his hand into his Life Deck
findings.expected: {damageStages:2} with no ifSuccessful; the shuffle effect has no vocabulary and should be needsReview.

findings.name: Black Snap Kick
findings.defect: Same mis-gating: the printed "If successful" clause is the attach-to-Non-Combat effect, but the parse stamps ifSuccessful onto the unconditional +3 power stage damage modifier, misclassifying attack damage as a step-15 post-success effect.
findings.evidence: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. If successful, attach to one of your opponent's Non-Combat cards in play.
findings.expected: {damageStages:3} with no ifSuccessful; the attach effect is unmodelable and should be needsReview.

findings.name: Black Style Mastery
findings.defect: The Mastery does not stop anything itself — it grants OTHER Black Style cards the ability to stop focused attacks. The parse gives the Mastery its own stopAttack (attackType 'any', window 'thisAttack') under a 'defense' trigger, inventing a universal attack-stopper the card does not have. A Mastery is a permanent in-play card and should be 'constant'.
findings.evidence: Your Black Style Non-Drill cards that can stop attacks can also stop focused attacks.
findings.expected: trigger 'constant' with no stopAttack effect; the granted focused-stop permission is unmodelable (needsReview).

findings.name: Black Style Mastery
findings.defect: The anger raise requires discarding a Black Style card during your "Attacker Attacks" phase, and it comes packaged with a 6-power-stage gain. The parse applies changeAnger +1 with no discard cost and drops the power stage gain, which changePowerStages can express.
findings.evidence: You may discard a Black Style card from your hand during your "Attacker Attacks" phase to raise your anger 1 level and have a Main Personality gain 6 power stages.
findings.expected: cost {discard:1} with [{changeAnger user +1},{changePowerStages target:'user', delta:+6}]

findings.name: Red Back Kick
findings.defect: The anger clause is dropped entirely. The parse has no changeAnger effect, so the foe's anger never moves when this attack resolves.
findings.evidence: Foe's anger level decreases by 1.
findings.expected: Add {kind:'changeAnger', target:'foe', delta:-1} alongside the physicalAttack and damageStages effects.

findings.name: Red Back Kick
findings.defect: The energy-attack stop is scoped to a single current attack. The card is a combat-long lockout of ALL energy attacks, but the parse expires it after one attack, so the opponent's second and later energy attacks this combat resolve unhindered.
findings.evidence: Stops all energy attacks for the rest of this combat.
findings.expected: stopAttack with window:'thisCombat' and scope:'all', not window:'thisAttack'.

findings.name: Saiyan Pressure Punch
findings.defect: The entire damage modifier is dropped — the parse is a bare physicalAttack, so it resolves at raw Physical Attack Table damage with no bonus. This is the single largest damage error in the batch (the card is silently 3 stages weaker than printed). The OCR misspelling of 'successful' likely defeated the parser.
findings.evidence: Physical attack doing +3 stages of physical damage if succesful.
findings.expected: Add {kind:'damageStages', stages:3, ifSuccessful:true}, matching how sibling cards (Red Palm Heel Strike, Red Reverse Punch) are parsed.

findings.name: Saiyan Energy Aura
findings.defect: Only the delayed half of the card is parsed. The two stop clauses were collapsed into one stopAttack with window 'nextPhase', so the card no longer stops the attack it is played against — it would fail as a defense in the moment it is used. CRD errata (Saiyan Saga #95) confirms both halves: 'Stops an energy attack and stops an energy attack during your opponent's next Attacker Attacks phase.'
findings.evidence: Stops an energy attack and stops energy attacks in the next phase.
findings.expected: Two effects: stopAttack{energy, window:'thisAttack'} AND stopAttack{energy, window:'nextPhase'}.

findings.name: Saiyan Sweeping Defense
findings.defect: The mirror-image error of Saiyan Energy Aura: only the immediate stop is parsed and the next-phase stop is dropped, so the opponent's next Attacker Attacks phase is not protected. CRD errata (Saiyan Saga #96) confirms both stops.
findings.evidence: and stops a physical attack during your opponent's next "Attacker Attacks" phase
findings.expected: Add a second stopAttack{attackType:'physical', window:'nextPhase'}.

findings.name: Saiyan Training
findings.defect: The restriction list invents a personality that does not appear in the text. 'Gohan' is in namedOnly but the card names only Villains and Goku, so the engine would let a Hero Gohan deck play a card it is not legal to play. CRD errata (Saiyan Saga #80) also reads 'Villains and Goku only.'
findings.evidence: Villains and Goku only.
findings.expected: restriction.namedOnly should be ['Villains','Goku'] — drop 'Gohan'.

findings.name: Saiyan City Destruction
findings.defect: The alignment restriction is dropped — the parse carries no restriction object at all, so a Hero deck could play this Villain-only card. The parser demonstrably supports this (Roshi Training in the same batch correctly carries restriction.alignment 'Hero' from 'Heroes only').
findings.evidence: Villains only.
findings.expected: restriction: {alignment: 'Villain'}.

findings.name: T-Rex Defense
findings.defect: A Defense Shield is parsed as an ordinary in-the-moment stop. window:'thisAttack' makes it stop whatever attack is currently being declared, but a Defense Shield only fires on the first attack that is NOT otherwise stopped — the vocabulary has a dedicated window for exactly this. As parsed the shield burns early and removes itself from the game against an attack the player would have stopped anyway.
findings.evidence: stop the first unstopped attack performed against you
findings.expected: stopAttack with window:'firstSuccessful' (the enum's documented meaning: 'the first that gets through').

findings.name: Red Coordination Drill
findings.defect: A conditional recurring Drill trigger is parsed as a one-shot onPlay. The card draws every time you enter Combat as the DEFENDER; as parsed it draws once when the Drill hits the table and never again — and it draws regardless of whether you are defending.
findings.evidence: When entering combat as the defender you may draw a card.
findings.expected: trigger: 'whenEnteringCombat' (the enum has this trigger), not 'onPlay'.

findings.name: Red Knee Pick Drill
findings.defect: Same defect as Red Coordination Drill: the recurring entering-Combat trigger is flattened to a single draw on play, and the attacker-side condition is lost.
findings.evidence: When entering Combat as the attacker, you may draw a card.
findings.expected: trigger: 'whenEnteringCombat', not 'onPlay'.

findings.name: Raditz Total Defense
findings.defect: The power-stage cost is dropped — the parse has no cost object, so the defense is free. AbilityCost.powerStages is available and is used correctly elsewhere in this same batch (Saiyan Energy Blast, Straining Tripping Move).
findings.evidence: but costs 1 power stage to perform
findings.expected: cost: {powerStages: 1}.

findings.name: Straining Fake Left Move
findings.defect: The 4 power stage cost is dropped, making a heavily-costed prevention card free to use. This is the largest missing cost in the batch.
findings.evidence: Costs 4 power stages to use.
findings.expected: cost: {powerStages: 4} alongside the preventLifeCards effect.

findings.name: Straining Energy Defense Move
findings.defect: The mandatory hand-discard cost is dropped, so the stop resolves with no card cost. AbilityCost.discard exists for exactly this.
findings.evidence: You must discard a card from your hand as a cost to use this card.
findings.expected: cost: {discard: 1}.

findings.name: Straining Head Lock Move
findings.defect: Same as Straining Energy Defense Move — the required hand discard is not encoded, so the physical stop is free.
findings.evidence: You must discard a card from your hand as a cost to use this card.
findings.expected: cost: {discard: 1}.

findings.name: Saiyan Arm Throw
findings.defect: The next-phase lockout rider is dropped; the parse is a bare physicalAttack. The vocabulary models this (stopAttack window 'nextPhase' is documented as 'foe's next'), and the parser applies it on Saiyan Energy Aura in this same batch. Note this rider is NOT gated on success, so it is immediate.
findings.evidence: Your opponent cannot perform a physical attack during their next "Attacker Attacks" phase.
findings.expected: Add stopAttack{attackType:'physical', window:'nextPhase'}.

findings.name: Saiyan Full Spin Kick
findings.defect: The next-phase energy lockout rider is dropped, leaving only a bare physicalAttack. Note the lockout here is on ENERGY attacks, not physical — a parse that copies the Arm Throw rider would be wrong.
findings.evidence: Your opponent cannot perform an energy attack during their next "Attacker Attacks" phase.
findings.expected: Add stopAttack{attackType:'energy', window:'nextPhase'}.

findings.name: Saiyan Neck Hold
findings.defect: The cost is captured but the next-phase physical lockout rider is dropped, so the card pays 2 power stages for a plain physical attack with no rider.
findings.evidence: Your opponent cannot perform a physical attack during their next "Attacker Attacks" phase.
findings.expected: Add stopAttack{attackType:'physical', window:'nextPhase'} to the existing physicalAttack + cost.

findings.name: Krillin's Energy Attack
findings.defect: The card states a fixed damage amount (2 life cards) but the parse emits a bare energyAttack with no lifeCards, so the engine falls back to the 4-life-card energy default and deals DOUBLE the printed damage. The needsReview flag does not prevent it from resolving wrong.
findings.evidence: Energy attack doing 2 draws from the life card deck if not stopped.
findings.expected: { kind: 'energyAttack', lifeCards: 2 }

findings.name: Nappa's Energy Aura
findings.defect: The card stops the current energy attack AND locks out all energy attacks for the rest of Combat; the parse keeps only the single thisAttack stop, silently dropping the combat-long lockout that the vocabulary supports via window 'thisCombat'.
findings.evidence: and stop all energy attacks performed against you for the remainder of Combat
findings.expected: a second { kind: 'stopAttack', attackType: 'energy', window: 'thisCombat', scope: 'all' } alongside the thisAttack stop (CRD errata line 1930 splits it into two sentences: "Stops an energy attack. Stops all energy attacks performed against you for the remainder of Combat.")

findings.name: Nappa's Physical Resistance
findings.defect: Same as Nappa's Energy Aura: the combat-long lockout is dropped and only the one-shot stop survives, so the engine lets every subsequent physical attack through.
findings.evidence: and stop all physical attacks performed against you for the remainder of Combat
findings.expected: a second { kind: 'stopAttack', attackType: 'physical', window: 'thisCombat', scope: 'all' } (CRD errata line 1933)

findings.name: Goku's Truce
findings.defect: The card stops EITHER attack type, but the parse hard-codes attackType 'energy', so the engine will refuse to use it against a physical attack — half the card's function is gone.
findings.evidence: Stops a physical or energy attack.
findings.expected: { kind: 'stopAttack', attackType: 'any', window: 'thisAttack' }

findings.name: Mother's Touch
findings.defect: Same 'physical or energy' -> 'energy' collapse: the parse cannot stop a physical attack even though the printed text and the CRD errata (line 1888) both say it stops either type.
findings.evidence: Stops a physical or energy attack. Remove from the game after use.
findings.expected: { kind: 'stopAttack', attackType: 'any', window: 'thisAttack' }

findings.name: Piccolo's Flight
findings.defect: Parse restricts the stop to energy attacks; the text covers both types. The engine would decline this card against a physical attack.
findings.evidence: Stops a successful physical or energy attack.
findings.expected: { kind: 'stopAttack', attackType: 'any' }

findings.name: It's the Little Things That Matter
findings.defect: The shield covers both attack types but the parse hard-codes attackType 'physical', so the engine never fires it against an energy attack. (Mirror of the same bug that turned the 'physical or energy' cards into energy-only.)
findings.evidence: Stops the first unstopped energy or physical attack performed against you this combat.
findings.expected: { kind: 'stopAttack', attackType: 'any', window: 'firstSuccessful' }

findings.name: Gohan's Physical Attack
findings.defect: The parse drops the power-stage gain entirely; the user ends the attack 5 stages lower than the card grants, which also changes every subsequent Physical Attack Table result.
findings.evidence: Gain 5 power stages.
findings.expected: { kind: 'changePowerStages', target: 'user', delta: 5 } in addition to physicalAttack and changeAnger (CRD errata line 1645 keeps the clause)

findings.name: Piccolo's Physical Defense
findings.defect: Only the stop is parsed; the 4-stage gain the card grants the defender is missing, so defending with this card leaves the user 4 power stages short.
findings.evidence: Gain 4 power stages.
findings.expected: { kind: 'changePowerStages', target: 'user', delta: 4 } alongside the stopAttack (CRD errata line 2029 confirms the clause)

findings.name: Power Up!
findings.defect: The parse keeps only the rejuvenation and drops the power-stage gain, which is the card's primary effect.
findings.evidence: Gain 5 power stages.
findings.expected: { kind: 'changePowerStages', target: 'user', delta: 5 } plus the existing rejuvenate

findings.name: Hidden Power Level
findings.defect: The parse is a bare physical attack; the power-stage reset to maximum — the entire reason to play the card — is dropped, even though the vocabulary has movePowerStage for exactly this.
findings.evidence: Raise your Main Personality to its highest power stage.
findings.expected: { kind: 'movePowerStage', target: 'user', to: 'highest' } alongside physicalAttack (CRD errata line 1744)

findings.name: Power Up the Most!
findings.defect: Only the rejuvenate half of the card is parsed; the raise-to-highest-power-stage half is dropped despite movePowerStage existing in the vocabulary.
findings.evidence: Raise one of your personalities in play to its highest power stage.
findings.expected: { kind: 'movePowerStage', target: 'user', to: 'highest' } plus the existing rejuvenate

findings.name: Piccolo Sidestep!
findings.defect: The card's after-use consequence (leaving the game rather than going to the discard pile) is not parsed, so the engine returns it to the discard pile where it can be rejuvenated back into the Life Deck and reused.
findings.evidence: Discard from the game after use.
findings.expected: { kind: 'removeFromGameAfterUse' } alongside the stopAttack — the parser emits this effect for the sibling cards that say "Remove from the game after use."

findings.name: Fall 7 times, get up 8 times.
findings.defect: A Defense Shield is not a card played against the current attack: per CRD step 7 ("If the attack was not stopped, the defender must now activate any Defense Shields from his cards in play") it fires on the first attack that gets through this combat. window 'thisAttack' models it as an ordinary in-hand stop, letting the engine spend it at the wrong point in the battle sequence (e.g. on an attack another card already stopped).
findings.evidence: Stops the first unstopped physical attack performed against you this combat.
findings.expected: { kind: 'stopAttack', attackType: 'physical', window: 'firstSuccessful' }

findings.name: Fortify Your Spirit
findings.defect: Same Defense Shield window error as "Fall 7 times, get up 8 times.": 'first unstopped ... this combat' is the firstSuccessful window, not thisAttack, so the shield's automatic step-7 timing is lost.
findings.evidence: Stops the first unstopped energy attack performed against you this combat.
findings.expected: { kind: 'stopAttack', attackType: 'energy', window: 'firstSuccessful' }

findings.name: Orange Uniting Strike
findings.defect: The 8-life-card damage is CONDITIONAL on Goku and Gohan both being in play, but the parse sets energyAttack.lifeCards=8 unconditionally. The card's actual base is the energy-attack default (4 life cards); the engine will deal 8 every time, doubling the card's damage in the normal case.
findings.evidence: If Goku and Gohan are in play, this attack does 8 life cards of damage instead.
findings.expected: energyAttack with no lifeCards override (default 4), with the conditional 8 flagged in needsReview

findings.name: Saiyan Energy Surprise
findings.defect: The 7-life-card damage only applies if a Tokui-Waza was declared, but the parse sets energyAttack.lifeCards=7 unconditionally, so the engine deals 7 instead of the default 4 even for a player with no declared Tokui-Waza.
findings.evidence: If you declared a Tokui-Waza, this attack does 7 life cards of damage.
findings.expected: energyAttack with no lifeCards override (default 4); the conditional 7 is not expressible and belongs in needsReview

findings.name: Red Flying Attack
findings.defect: The +5 power stage modifier is gated on declaring a Tokui-Waza, but the parse emits damageStages 5 unconditionally, so every use of this card gets +5 stages of damage on the Physical Attack Table result.
findings.evidence: If you declared a Tokui-Waza, this attack does +5 power stages of damage.
findings.expected: physicalAttack alone (plain PAT damage), with the conditional +5 flagged in needsReview

findings.name: Orange Aggressive Technique
findings.defect: The parse pulls the '+2 life cards' number out of the rider (which boosts this personality's FUTURE energy attacks) and uses it as a fixed base-damage override on THIS physical attack, so the attack deals a flat 2 life cards instead of Physical Attack Table damage. It simultaneously drops the actual '+2 power stages' modifier the attack does have.
findings.evidence: Focused physical attack doing +2 power stages of damage. If successful, all energy attacks this personality performs for the remainder of Combat do +2 life cards of damage.
findings.expected: physicalAttack (no lifeCards) + damageStages 2; the remainder-of-Combat energy boost is an unmodelable floating effect

findings.name: Prepared Dodge
findings.defect: The card stops EITHER attack type, but the parse restricts stopAttack.attackType to 'energy'. The engine will refuse to use this card against a physical attack, silently losing half the card's function.
findings.evidence: Stops a physical or energy attack.
findings.expected: stopAttack with attackType 'any', window 'thisAttack'

findings.name: Red Energy Gathering Drill
findings.defect: The text names 'energy' explicitly, but the parse widens stopAttack.attackType to 'any', so the drill will also stop physical attacks — strictly stronger than the printed card. (The stray backslash in the scan broke the parser's 'energy attack' match; the word 'energy' is still unambiguous.)
findings.evidence: Stops the first unNstopped energy \ attack performed against LOU during Combat.
findings.expected: stopAttack with attackType 'energy'

findings.name: Red Anger Rising
findings.defect: damageStages 1 is attached to this attack, but the text grants no bonus to this attack at all: it is a remainder-of-Combat floating effect that scales per Dragon Ball in play. With zero Dragon Balls in play the bonus is +0, so the parse invents damage that does not exist (and mis-scopes a global effect onto one attack). Compare Saiyan Blocking Technique in this same batch, where the equivalent remainder-of-Combat bonus was correctly omitted.
findings.evidence: For the remainder of Combat all physical attacks do +1 power stages of damage for each Dragon Ball in play.
findings.expected: physicalAttack + changeAnger user +1 only; drop damageStages

findings.name: Red Energy Surprise
findings.defect: The anger gain is dropped entirely — the parse has only the energy attack. changeAnger is in the vocabulary, and the parser's anger regex requires the word 'level' after 'anger', so the 'gain 2 anger' phrasing slips through unparsed.
findings.evidence: If successful, gain 2 anger.
findings.expected: energyAttack lifeCards 5 + changeAnger target 'user' delta +2

findings.name: Red Fist Lunge
findings.defect: The foe anger reduction is parsed as -1 but the card lowers the opponent's anger by 2 levels. The parser's anger regex grabbed the '1' from the preceding self-anger clause.
findings.evidence: lower your opponent's anger 2 levels
findings.expected: changeAnger target 'foe' delta -2

findings.name: Red Fist Lunge
findings.defect: The user-anger raise is missing from the parse; only the foe-anger effect was emitted. Both anger changes are printed on the card and both are expressible.
findings.evidence: If successful, raise your anger 1 level and lower your opponent's anger 2 levels.
findings.expected: changeAnger target 'user' delta +1 in addition to the foe effect

findings.name: Namekian Quick Blast
findings.defect: The card removes itself from the game after a successful use, but the parse has only the energy attack. removeFromGameAfterUse is in the vocabulary and was applied correctly on other cards in this same batch (Orange Energy Setup, Red Shielded Strike), so the engine will let this card be recurred/replayed when it should be gone.
findings.evidence: If successful, remove from the game.
findings.expected: energyAttack lifeCards 5 + removeFromGameAfterUse

findings.name: Orange Energy Concentration
findings.defect: discardCards on the foe is doubly gated (attack must be successful AND a Tokui-Waza must have been declared), but the Effect has no conditional field, so the engine will make the opponent discard on every use — including when the attack is stopped and when no Tokui-Waza was declared.
findings.evidence: If successful, and you declared a Tokui-Waza, your opponent discards a card from his hand.
findings.expected: energyAttack + cost 3 power stages only; the conditional discard is not expressible and belongs in needsReview

findings.name: Red Shifty Maneuver
findings.defect: changeAnger user +1 is emitted unconditionally, but raising anger only happens if a Tokui-Waza was declared. Every use of this stop will now also raise the user's anger.
findings.evidence: If you declared a Tokui-Waza, raise your anger 1 level and discard a Drill in play.
findings.expected: stopAttack physical only; the Tokui-Waza-gated anger raise flagged in needsReview

findings.name: Orange Energy Setup
findings.defect: The stop is an ALTERNATIVE mode ('instead') and is gated on declaring a Tokui-Waza, yet it sits alongside energyAttack in a single attack-triggered effect list, so the engine both performs an energy attack and stops a physical attack from one play, with no Tokui-Waza requirement.
findings.evidence: If you declared Tokui-Waza, you may use this card to stop a physical attack instead.
findings.expected: energyAttack + removeFromGameAfterUse; the conditional alternative stop mode flagged in needsReview rather than emitted as a co-resolving effect

findings.name: Namekian Fist Dodge
findings.defect: The card is dual-mode, but the parse keeps only the defense mode (trigger 'defense', stopAttack) and drops the attack mode entirely, so the engine can never play this as a physical attack. The parser handles the same construction correctly elsewhere in the corpus — 'Energy attack, or stops an energy attack' is parsed as trigger 'attack' with both energyAttack and stopAttack.
findings.evidence: Physical attack, or stops a physical attack.
findings.expected: trigger 'attack' with effects [physicalAttack, stopAttack physical] (same convention as the 'Energy attack, or stops an energy attack' cards)

findings.name: Namekian Power Stance Drill
findings.defect: A Defense Shield fires automatically on the first attack that is NOT otherwise stopped (CRD battle-sequence step 7; CRD glossary: Defense Shields attempt to stop the first unstopped attack). The parse sets window 'thisAttack', i.e. an ordinary same-window stop, losing the 'first that gets through, once per Combat' semantics. The enum has 'firstSuccessful' for exactly this; the parser's firstSuccessful branch only matches the literal phrase 'first successful', so 'first unstopped' falls through.
findings.evidence: Defense Shield: Stops the first unstopped physical attack performed against you during Combat.

findings.defect: Defense Shield window mis-set to 'thisAttack' instead of 'firstSuccessful' — the shield stops the first attack that is not otherwise stopped, not the currently declared attack in the normal stop window.

findings.name: Orange Burning Aura Drill
findings.defect: Defense Shield window mis-set to 'thisAttack' instead of 'firstSuccessful' — the shield stops the first attack that is not otherwise stopped, not the currently declared attack in the normal stop window.

findings.name: Orange Steady Drill

findings.evidence: Defense Shield: Stops the first unstopped energy attack performed against you during Combat.
findings.expected: stopAttack attackType 'energy', window 'firstSuccessful'

findings.name: Red Forward Stance Drill
findings.defect: Defense Shield window mis-set to 'thisAttack' instead of 'firstSuccessful' — the shield stops the first attack that is not otherwise stopped, not the currently declared attack in the normal stop window.
findings.evidence: Defense Shield: Stops the first unstopped physical attack performed against you during Combat.
findings.expected: stopAttack attackType 'physical', window 'firstSuccessful'

findings.name: Saiyan Energy Drill
findings.defect: Defense Shield window mis-set to 'thisAttack' instead of 'firstSuccessful' — the shield stops the first attack that is not otherwise stopped, not the currently declared attack in the normal stop window.
findings.evidence: Defense Shield: Stops the first unstopped energy attack performed against you during Combat.
findings.expected: stopAttack attackType 'energy', window 'firstSuccessful'

findings.name: Red Energy Gathering Drill
findings.defect: Second, separate defect on this card: the Defense Shield window is also set to 'thisAttack' instead of 'firstSuccessful'.
findings.evidence: Stops the first unNstopped energy \ attack performed against LOU during Combat.
findings.expected: stopAttack window 'firstSuccessful' (with attackType 'energy')

findings.name: Black Head Strike
findings.defect: "+2 life cards" is an ADDITIVE modifier on top of the physical attack's normal PAT power-stage damage, but the parse sets physicalAttack.lifeCards=2, which per abilities.ts OVERRIDES the default base — the engine will deal a flat 2 life cards and NO power-stage damage.
findings.expected: physicalAttack with no lifeCards override plus an additive +2 life-card modifier (no such Effect kind exists — better to leave the rider unmodeled/manual than to convert it into a fixed base)

findings.name: Captain Ginyu Moves to Attack!
findings.defect: Same fixed-base confusion: "+3 life cards" is a modifier added to PAT stage damage, but physicalAttack.lifeCards=3 replaces the base, so the engine deals exactly 3 life cards and drops all power-stage damage.
findings.expected: physicalAttack with default PAT base (no lifeCards override); the +3 life cards is an unmodeled additive rider
findings.evidence: Physical attack doing +3 life cards of damage.

findings.name: Dodoria's Waiting Game
findings.defect: Same fixed-base confusion: "+2 life cards" parsed as physicalAttack.lifeCards=2, overriding the PAT base instead of adding to it.
findings.expected: physicalAttack with default PAT base (no lifeCards override)
findings.evidence: Physical attack doing +2 life cards of damage.

findings.name: Vegeta's Surprise Defense
findings.defect: The card stops EITHER attack type, but the parse restricts attackType to "energy" — the engine will refuse to use this card against a physical attack, which is half of what it does.
findings.expected: stopAttack with attackType "any", window "thisAttack"
findings.evidence: Stops a physical or energy attack.

findings.name: Black Defensive Aura
findings.defect: Card stops either attack type but the parse restricts attackType to "energy", so the engine cannot use it against a physical attack.
findings.expected: stopAttack with attackType "any"
findings.evidence: Stops an opponent's physical or energy attack.

findings.name: Black Defensive Aura
findings.defect: The 1-power-stage cost is dropped entirely — no cost object on the ability — so the engine stops attacks for free.
findings.expected: cost: { powerStages: 1 }
findings.evidence: Costs 1 power stage to perform.

findings.name: Namekian Energy Drill
findings.defect: This is a recurring triggered Drill ability, but it is parsed as trigger "onPlay" with drawCards 1 — the engine hands out one free card the moment the Drill is played and never again, instead of after each successful energy attack. The hand-to-Life-Deck cost is also dropped, making the draw free.
findings.expected: trigger "constant" (Drill/continuous) rather than onPlay; the per-successful-energy-attack draw is not an on-play draw
findings.evidence: After every successful energy attack you perform, choose a card from your hand and put it at the bottom of your Life Deck in order to draw a card.

findings.name: Black Energy Web
findings.defect: The lockout is parsed with window "thisAttack", so the engine only stops the single current attack instead of every energy attack for the rest of Combat — and this rider is gated on "If successful", which window "thisAttack" misrepresents entirely.
findings.expected: stopAttack with attackType "energy", window "thisCombat", scope "all"
findings.evidence: If successful, also stops an opponent from performing any energy attacks for the remainder of Combat.

findings.name: Blue Somach Eruption
findings.defect: The combat-long physical lockout is parsed as window "thisAttack", so the engine stops only one attack rather than all of the opponent's physical attacks for the remainder of Combat.
findings.expected: stopAttack with attackType "physical", window "thisCombat", scope "all"
findings.evidence: also stop all opponent's physical attacks for the remainder of Combat

findings.name: Blue Somach Eruption
findings.defect: The anger loss on the card user is missing from the parse — no changeAnger effect at all. Per errata-era wording "your anger" is the USER's anger, so the engine skips a real downside of the card.
findings.expected: changeAnger { target: "user", delta: -1 }
findings.evidence: Lower your anger 1 levels.

findings.name: Vegeta's Physical Stance
findings.defect: Only the single-attack stop is parsed; the second, much larger clause — a lockout of all physical attacks against you for the rest of Combat — is dropped, so the engine under-applies the card by an entire effect.
findings.expected: a second stopAttack { attackType: "physical", window: "thisCombat", scope: "all" } alongside the thisAttack stop
findings.evidence: and stop all physical attacks performed against you for the remainder of Combat

findings.name: Black Defensive Burst
findings.defect: The if-successful physical-attack lockout is entirely absent from the parse — only the 3-life-card attack is modeled, so the opponent keeps attacking physically all Combat.
findings.expected: physicalAttack lifeCards 3 plus stopAttack { attackType: "physical", window: "thisCombat", scope: "all" }
findings.evidence: If successful, your opponent cannot perform physical attacks for the remainder of Combat.

findings.name: Black Driving Palm Strike
findings.defect: Only the opponent's anger drop is parsed; the user's own anger gain is missing. The parse has changeAnger foe -1 but no changeAnger user +1, so the engine applies half the anger swing.
findings.expected: changeAnger { target: "user", delta: 1 } in addition to changeAnger { target: "foe", delta: -1 }
findings.evidence: Raise your anger 1 level. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level.

findings.name: Black Finger Block
findings.defect: The power-stage gain is dropped — the parse contains only the stopAttack, so the user never gains the 3 stages.
findings.expected: changePowerStages { target: "user", delta: 3 } alongside the stopAttack
findings.evidence: Your Main Personality gains 3 power stages.

findings.name: Frieza's Finger Tip Energy Blast
findings.defect: "Lowers anger to 0" is a SET, not a delta, but the parse emits changeAnger { target: foe, delta: 0 } — a literal no-op. The engine will resolve this card as changing the opponent's anger by nothing while the board shows an effect was applied.
findings.expected: an anger-to-zero effect (changeAnger has no toZero flag, unlike changePowerStages) — a delta-0 effect is strictly worse than omitting it or flagging manual
findings.evidence: it also lowers an opponent's anger to 0

findings.name: Goku's Battle Ready
findings.defect: Same delta-0 no-op: "Lower opponents anger to 0" is parsed as changeAnger { target: foe, delta: 0 }, which changes nothing when it should wipe the opponent's anger.
findings.expected: an anger-to-zero effect, not delta 0
findings.evidence: Lower opponents anger to 0.

findings.name: Frieza's Irritation Grows
findings.defect: The anger gain is variable — 1 level per copy in the discard pile — but the parse hardcodes changeAnger user +1. The first copy played typically has 0 copies in the discard pile, so the engine grants anger the card does not.
findings.expected: a count-dependent anger gain (no vocabulary for it); a flat +1 is not the printed amount
findings.evidence: raise your anger 1 level for every "Frieza's Irritation Grows" in your discard pile

findings.name: Black Physical Focus
findings.defect: The parse emits an unconditional damageStages 1 with no cost, but the +1 stage of damage only exists per power stage the attacker voluntarily pays. The engine grants a free +1 damage stage on every use.
findings.expected: physicalAttack alone (variable pay-X damage is unmodelable); an unconditional damageStages 1 with no matching cost is invented damage
findings.evidence: For each power stage paid, do +1 power stages of damage.

findings.name: Android 20 Absorbing Drill
findings.defect: The activation cost is dropped — the parse has stopAttack with no cost at all, so the engine stops energy attacks for free and repeatedly, when each use should cost 2 life cards.
findings.expected: the stopAttack gated behind a 2-life-card cost (cost.discard is the nearest slot; leaving the cost off makes the card strictly better than printed)
findings.evidence: Discard 2 life cards to stop an energy attack.

findings.name: Orange Junction Energy Blast
findings.defect: Parse sets energyAttack.lifeCards = 1, which per abilities.ts is a FIXED base that OVERRIDES the default. The text never states a base damage; the 1 is a per-ally bonus. The engine will deal 1 life card instead of the default 4 (plus bonus) — a 4x under-count at zero allies and worse at one.
findings.expected: energyAttack with no lifeCards override (base 4 per CRD line 343: "If an energy attack does not state the amount of damage it does, the Base Damage is 4 life cards"); the +1-per-ally rider is unmodelable and should be flagged, not folded into the base.
findings.evidence: This attack does +1 life card of damage for each ally that you have in play.

findings.name: Red Implosion Lunge
findings.defect: "+3 life cards" is a MODIFIER on top of the physical attack's PAT damage, but the parse encodes it as physicalAttack.lifeCards = 3, which the schema defines as a fixed base that OVERRIDES the default. The engine will deal a flat 3 life cards and deal ZERO power stages of PAT damage, when the card should deal full PAT power stages plus 3 life cards.
findings.expected: physicalAttack with no lifeCards override (PAT base retained); the "+3 life cards" rider has no Effect kind (damageStages is power-stages only) and should be left unmodelled/flagged rather than converted into a fixed base.
findings.evidence: Physical attack doing +3 life cards of damage.

findings.name: Orange Special Beam Cannon
findings.defect: Damage is variable (1 life card per power stage above 0), but the parse encodes energyAttack.lifeCards = 1, a fixed base. An attacker at 5 power stages should deal 5 life cards; the engine will deal 1. The fixed value is wrong at every power level except exactly 1 stage, and it also suppresses the 4-life-card default.
findings.expected: No fixed lifeCards value — the variable base is unmodelable, so this should be energyAttack flagged for review (or manual), not a silent lifeCards: 1.
findings.evidence: Energy attack doing 1 life card of damage for each of the attacking personality's power stages above 0.

findings.name: Trunks Draws Steel
findings.defect: The card is modal ("or"), but the parse puts physicalAttack AND stopAttack in one attack-triggered ability, so the engine resolves both. CRD line 742: "Some cards can perform AND stop attacks. Such cards can only be played as either an attack or to stop an attack. They cannot do both when they are used."
findings.expected: Only one mode may resolve. Either a single physicalAttack under trigger 'attack' (with the defensive mode flagged/manual) or two separate abilities — never both effects firing together.
findings.evidence: Physical attack or stop a physical attack.

findings.name: Red Gravity Drill
findings.defect: Text stops a physical OR an energy attack, but the parse narrows attackType to 'energy'. The engine will refuse to use this Drill against physical attacks — exactly half its printed function is silently unavailable.
findings.expected: stopAttack with attackType: 'any', window 'thisAttack'.
findings.evidence: Discard your hand to stop a physical or energy attack.

findings.name: Orange Dashing Gut Punch
findings.defect: The parse contains only physicalAttack. The power-stage gain is dropped entirely even though changePowerStages is in the Effect vocabulary, so the attacker never gains the 3 stages.
findings.expected: Add { kind: 'changePowerStages', target: 'user', delta: 3 } alongside physicalAttack.
findings.evidence: Your main personality gains 3 power stages.

findings.name: Trunks High Strike
findings.defect: The parse contains only physicalAttack. The 5-power-stage gain is dropped despite changePowerStages being available in the Effect vocabulary.
findings.expected: Add { kind: 'changePowerStages', target: 'user', delta: 5 } (the "if successful" gate is a known schema gap, but the effect itself should be present).
findings.evidence: If successful, also gain 5 power stages.

findings.name: Trunks Sword Position 1
findings.defect: The card changes BOTH players' anger, but the parse keeps only the opponent's -1 and drops the user's +1. The user's anger never rises, which affects anger-threshold level advancement.
findings.expected: Add { kind: 'changeAnger', target: 'user', delta: 1 } in addition to the existing foe -1.
findings.evidence: Raise your anger 1 level. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level.

findings.name: Red Energy Shield

findings.expected: Add { kind: 'movePowerStage', target: 'user', to: 'highest' } ("any personality" is a player choice; user is the engine's normal resolution).
findings.evidence: Raise any personality to their highest power stage.

findings.name: Trunks Stands Ready
findings.defect: Parsed with trigger 'defense' (schema: "used to defend (starburst)"), but this Non-Combat card stops no attack — it only shuts off Constant Combat Powers. The parser appears to have triggered on the word "Stops". The engine will offer it as a defense option that stops nothing, and its only modelled effect is removeFromGameAfterUse.
findings.expected: trigger 'onPlay' (Non-Combat, on play/use), with the Constant-Combat-Power shutdown left unmodelled.
findings.evidence: Stops all "Constant Combat Powers" from working for the remainder of this combat.

findings.name: Trunks Strikes
findings.defect: The card offers the attacker a choice of damage mode, but the parse silently commits to one (3 life cards) and discards the 5-power-stage mode. The engine will always deal 3 life cards even when the player would take the power-stage option.
findings.expected: The either/or choice is not expressible with the current Effect kinds; the parse should flag it (needsReview/manual) rather than lock in one mode as if it were the printed base.
findings.evidence: Physical attack doing 5 power stages of damage or 3 life cards of damage.

findings.name: Pan's High Slap
findings.defect: The attack's stated fixed base of 5 POWER STAGES is dropped entirely, and the parse instead sets lifeCards:3 — a number lifted from the unrelated damage-prevention clause. Per abilities.ts, lifeCards on physicalAttack is a fixed OVERRIDE, so the engine will resolve this as a physical attack dealing exactly 3 life cards instead of a stated 5 power stages (CRD line 343: PAT is used 'unless it is already stated on the physical attack').
findings.evidence: Focused physical attack doing 5 power stages of damage. ... prevent 3 life cards of damage from your opponent's attacks for the remainder of Combat.
findings.expected: {kind:'physicalAttack', powerStages:5}; the '3 life cards' belongs to a conditional preventLifeCards clause, not to the attack's base damage.

findings.name: Majin Buu's Wail
findings.defect: '+2 life cards ... for each card in your hand' is a per-card MODIFIER on top of the base (CRD line 433), but the parse encodes it as lifeCards:2, which abilities.ts defines as a fixed override of the energy default. The engine will deal 2 life cards where the card should deal the 4-life-card base plus 2 per card in hand — strictly less damage than an unparsed card would get.
findings.evidence: Energy attack doing +2 life cards of damage for each card in your hand.
findings.expected: {kind:'energyAttack'} with no lifeCards (default 4), since the schema has no life-card modifier effect; the scaling stays manual.

findings.name: Orange Might
findings.defect: This card's own attack is a bare 'Focused energy attack' (base 4 life cards). The parse's lifeCards:5 is taken from the optional FUTURE attack the card enables later in Combat, so the engine over-deals damage on the card's own attack.
findings.evidence: Focused energy attack. For the remainder of Combat, you may discard a card from your hand during your "Attacker Attacks" phase to perform either a physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage or an energy attack doing 5 life cards of damage.
findings.expected: {kind:'energyAttack'} with no lifeCards (default 4 per CRD line 343).

findings.name: Orange Might
findings.defect: discardCards{target:'user',count:1} is not a cost or effect of playing this card. The discard is an optional cost the player may pay LATER, during a subsequent 'Attacker Attacks' phase, to perform the granted attack. The engine will make the user discard a card immediately for nothing.
findings.evidence: you may discard a card from your hand during your "Attacker Attacks" phase to perform either a physical attack
findings.expected: no discardCards effect on this ability (the floating optional attack is unmodeled).

findings.name: Red Puppy Slap
findings.defect: '+3 life cards of damage' is a modifier added on top of the physical attack's PAT Base Damage (CRD line 433: modifiers are 'added on top of the Base Damage ... even if the attack doesn't deal the kind of damage that is being modified'). Encoding it as lifeCards:3 makes it a fixed override, deleting all Physical Attack Table damage.
findings.evidence: Physical attack doing +3 life cards of damage.
findings.expected: {kind:'physicalAttack'} with no lifeCards override; the +3 life-card modifier has no schema representation.

findings.name: Saiyan Stop
findings.defect: attackType is 'energy', but the card stops either type. The engine will refuse to let this card defend against a physical attack. (It also matters in reverse: per CRD line 1164, a card that stops BOTH types is precisely the kind that cannot stop a focused attack.)
findings.evidence: Stops a physical or energy attack.
findings.expected: {kind:'stopAttack', attackType:'any', window:'thisAttack'}

findings.name: Saiyan Stop
findings.defect: The power-stage gain is dropped despite changePowerStages being in the schema. Half of this card's value silently does nothing.

findings.expected: {kind:'changePowerStages', target:'user', delta:7}

findings.name: Saiyan Brace
findings.defect: attackType is 'energy', but the card stops a physical attack as well. The engine will reject it as a defense against physical attacks.
findings.evidence: Stops a physical or energy attack.

findings.name: Power Overwhelming
findings.defect: The power-stage gain is dropped entirely even though changePowerStages exists in the schema; this is a secondary effect that always resolves, not a conditional.

findings.expected: {kind:'changePowerStages', target:'user', delta:3} in addition to the attack and damageStages 8.

findings.name: Red Sword Cleave
findings.defect: The card changes BOTH anger levels, but only the opponent's decrease was parsed. The user's own anger raise is dropped, so the engine under-counts the user's anger (which gates personality level-ups).
findings.evidence: Raise your anger 1 level. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level.
findings.expected: both {kind:'changeAnger', target:'user', delta:1} and {kind:'changeAnger', target:'foe', delta:-1}.

findings.name: Orange Hand-clasp Drill
findings.defect: This Non-Combat Drill never stops an attack itself — it only grants the ability to stop FOCUSED attacks to the player's Defense Shields. The parse gives the card a stopAttack{attackType:'any'} of its own, so the engine will let a Drill be played as a defense and stop any attack outright.
findings.evidence: Your Defense Shields can stop focused attacks.
findings.expected: no stopAttack effect; at most a manual/constant note (the Defense Shield grant and the +1 PUR are unmodeled).

findings.name: Orange Hand-clasp Drill

findings.evidence: Your Main Personality's PUR is +1. Your Defense Shields can stop focused attacks.
findings.expected: trigger 'constant'.

findings.name: Red Bullrush Drill
findings.defect: This Non-Combat Drill does not stop attacks. 'When you stop an attack' is the CONDITION under which its Sensei-removal effect fires — a mention of stopping, not a stop. The parse gives the Drill stopAttack{attackType:'any'}, letting the engine stop an arbitrary attack with a Drill.
findings.evidence: When you stop an attack, remove from the game 1 card from your opponent's Sensei Deck.
findings.expected: no stopAttack effect; the constant '+2 life cards' damage bonus and the Sensei removal are both unmodeled.

findings.name: Red Bullrush Drill
findings.defect: Trigger is 'defense' on a Non-Combat Drill with purely continuous text; it should be a constant in-play effect.
findings.evidence: All of your attacks do +2 life cards of damage.
findings.expected: trigger 'constant'.

findings.name: Massacre of the Billions and Millions of Bountiful Mini Bitty Maliciously Baneful Majin Buus
findings.defect: Nothing in this card stops an attack. The only occurrence of 'stops' is the condition on a punishment effect aimed at the OPPONENT stopping a Majin attack. The parse gives the card stopAttack{attackType:'any', window:'thisAttack'}, so the engine can cancel any incoming attack with a card that has no such ability.
findings.evidence: if your opponent stops an attack performed by a Majin Personality. he must discard the top card of his Deck

findings.name: Massacre of the Billions and Millions of Bountiful Mini Bitty Maliciously Baneful Majin Buus

findings.evidence: or the remainder of Combat, all attacks performed by your Alies are focused attacks.

findings.name: Orange Carnage
findings.defect: ifSuccessful:true is attached to the damage modifier, but 'If successful' governs the discard-Allies clause. Per CRD, modifiers are added to Base Damage at battle-sequence step 10 while 'If successful' effects resolve at step 15 — deferring the +3 stages to step 15 applies it after damage has already been dealt.
findings.evidence: Focused physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage. If successful, discard up to 4 of your opponent's Allies in play.
findings.expected: {kind:'damageStages', stages:3} with no ifSuccessful; the 'If successful' clause (discarding Allies in play) is unmodeled.

findings.name: Orange Massacre
findings.defect: ifSuccessful:true is on the damage modifier, but 'If successful' governs the Freestyle-Drill removal three sentences later. The +4 stages are part of damage calculation (step 10), not a step-15 effect.
findings.evidence: Physical attack doing +4 power stages of damage. ... If successful, remove from the game all Freestyle Drills in play.
findings.expected: {kind:'damageStages', stages:4} with no ifSuccessful.

findings.name: Saiyan Lurch

findings.expected: {kind:'damageStages', stages:3} with no ifSuccessful.

findings.name: Saiyan Handstand
findings.defect: The ifSuccessful flag is on the wrong effect — it is set on the damage modifier (which is unconditional damage calculation) and NOT set on the anger raise (which is the actual 'If successful' effect). The engine will raise anger even when the attack is stopped, and defer the +5 stages past damage. Separately, the anger raise is scaled 'for each Dragon Ball you control' but parsed as a flat +1, so it fires for +1 even when the user controls zero Dragon Balls.
findings.evidence: Physical attack doing +5 power stages of damage. If successful, raise your anger 1 level for each Dragon Ball you control.
findings.expected: {kind:'damageStages', stages:5} with no ifSuccessful, and {kind:'changeAnger', target:'user', delta:1, ifSuccessful} — the per-Dragon-Ball scaling being unrepresentable argues for leaving the anger effect out entirely.

findings.name: Majin Hair Pull
findings.defect: The +3 stages are multiplied by the user's anger level, but the parse encodes an unconditional flat +3. The engine deals +3 when the correct amount is 0 (at anger 0, the common case) or 6, 9, ... at higher anger. It is correct only at exactly anger 1.
findings.evidence: Physical attack doing +3 power stages of damage for each anger level you have above 0.
findings.expected: no damageStages effect (the schema has no scaling field), leaving the bonus for manual resolution rather than asserting a flat wrong number.

findings.name: Red Left Bolt
findings.defect: The card draw is dropped even though drawCards exists in the schema. (The 'bottom' nuance is unrepresentable, but the card-count effect is not — the parse currently draws nothing.)

findings.expected: {kind:'drawCards', count:1} alongside the energy attack and removeFromGameAfterUse.

findings.name: Ally's Sacrifice

findings.expected: stopAttack with attackType 'any', window 'thisCombat', scope 'all'
findings.evidence: Stops all of your opponent's physical and energy attacks for the remainder of combat.

findings.name: Baba's Energy Blast

findings.expected: Not discardCards/hand — this is 3 life cards of damage to the foe's Life Deck (no hand loss)
findings.evidence: Your opponent discards 3 cards from his life deck.

findings.name: Black Arm Bar Drill

findings.expected: trigger 'constant'
findings.evidence: Stops the first energy attack made on you in a combat.

findings.name: Black Energy Stance

findings.evidence: Stops a physical or energy attack.

findings.name: Black Fore FIst Punch
findings.defect: The if-successful power-stage drain is dropped entirely; only the 6-life-card energy attack is modeled. Engine vocabulary covers this (changePowerStages, target foe). CRD line 1386 prints the same errata text.
findings.expected: add { kind: 'changePowerStages', target: 'foe', delta: -3 } (gated on the attack being successful)
findings.evidence: If successful, your opponent loses 3 power stages, to a minimum of 0.

findings.name: Black Godly Parry
findings.defect: Parse restricts the stop to energy attacks; the card stops either type, so the engine will not allow it against a physical attack.
findings.expected: stopAttack attackType 'any'
findings.evidence: Stops a physical or energy attack.

findings.name: Black Lunge
findings.defect: '+3 life cards' is a MODIFIER added on top of the physical attack's Physical Attack Table damage, but the parse encodes lifeCards: 3, which per abilities.ts is a fixed base that OVERRIDES the default. The attack would deal exactly 3 life cards and no power-stage table damage.
findings.expected: physicalAttack with no lifeCards override, plus a +3 life-card modifier (or leave the modifier flagged in needsReview rather than encoding it as a fixed base)
findings.evidence: Physical attack doing +3 life cards of damage.

findings.name: Black Takedown Drill

findings.expected: trigger 'constant' with the draw conditioned on a successful attack — not an immediate on-play draw
findings.evidence: Once per Combat, you may draw a card after performing a successful attack.

findings.name: Black Transformation
findings.defect: Parse restricts the stop to energy attacks; the card stops either type, so the engine will not allow it against a physical attack.
findings.expected: stopAttack attackType 'any'
findings.evidence: Stops a physical or energy attack.

findings.name: Blazing Anger!
findings.defect: The anger gain — the card's namesake and primary effect — is dropped; only the rejuvenation is parsed. changeAnger is available vocabulary and the wording is unambiguous.

findings.evidence: Increase your anger level by 2.

findings.name: Blue Backbreaker
findings.defect: Parse adds a stopAttack (any/thisAttack) that the card does not have. 'If you stopped an attack' is a CONDITION describing something that already happened last defense phase, not an effect. The engine would let this attack card also negate an incoming attack.
findings.expected: physicalAttack + damageStages 5 (+ conditional anger); no stopAttack effect
